app_fee.value: No PhD application fee is stated on BCGS PhD pages; PhD candidates apply directly to prospective supervisors at Bonn or Cologne (Uni Bonn states applying for admission at Bonn is free, while no joint Bonn-Cologne PhD fee statement is given).

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee or fee waiver is stated on BCGS or faculty PhD pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on BCGS PhD pages or faculty doctoral regulations.

toefl_min.value: No joint PhD TOEFL minimum is stated (BCGS's B2 rule on its FAQ is for MSc admission; at Bonn MNF ? 8(6), foreign-degree doctoral candidates writing and defending in English are exempted from language tests via a supervisor proficiency statement).

ielts_min.value: No joint PhD IELTS minimum is stated (BCGS's B2 rule on its FAQ is for MSc admission; at Bonn MNF ? 8(6), foreign-degree doctoral candidates writing and defending in English are exempted from language tests via a supervisor proficiency statement).

english_waiver.value: No joint Bonn-Cologne PhD rule on English-medium Indian degrees is stated (at Bonn MNF, supervisor certification of English proficiency suffices for an English-language doctorate; BCGS's MOI rule on its FAQ applies to MSc admission).
